split_rule: Independently per dataset: lexicographically sort string IDs; permute with numpy.default_rng(6304); first200 development and remaining800 evaluation. First50 MATH evaluation IDs in that permutation are live subset.
orders_rule: Ten seeded permutations of32 rollout IDs; nested prefixes; same saved orders across methods/controllers; average within question then across questions.
missing_answer_rule: Always incorrect; retained in voting, costs and accuracy denominators.

score_rules.calibration: Pool token KL from currently revealed candidates only; Q05/Q95 with linear interpolation; c=clip((k-Q05)/max(Q95-Q05,1e-8),0,1). Recompute per prefix.
score_rules.token_fusion: mean(c*v); difference from V*C equals population covariance(c,v)
score_rules.RWC: N>1: descending average ranks r, weight=(N-r)/(N-1); answer weights sum; N1 returns sole candidate.
score_rules.ties: Earliest supporting rollout in current order; average ranks for tied quality scores.

offline_cost: Sum retained token counts of consumed candidates; FirstAns consumes only first candidate. Excludes prefill/scoring/attention-collection overhead.

adaptive.agreement: Unique non-NO_ANSWER leading group with count/n >= tau.
adaptive.quality_aware: Agreement plus SC winner equals RWC winner and normalized vote margin >= gamma; K for MATH and VisConf for MathVista.
adaptive.margin: (largest-second_largest answer vote)/total weight; absent runner-up vote=0.
adaptive.selection: Per dataset/family: include always32 fallback; lowest mean retained-token cost with dev accuracy >= fixed32SC minus0.01 averaged across ten orders. Ties: higher accuracy, smaller tau, smaller gamma.
adaptive.output: Current self-consistency answer for both controllers.

live.problem_suffix: Think step by step inside <think> </think> tags, then give your final answer inside \boxed{}.
live.revision_instruction: Review the solution above. Identify and correct any errors; if it is correct, retain its answer. Give your final answer inside \boxed{}.
live.extractor: Find last literal \boxed{; scan balanced braces; trim contents. Absent, empty or unclosed last box => null. No numeric fallback.

leakage_rule: Gold/future candidates only for retrospective analysis. Never selector/controller/grouping/calibration inputs.
submission: Public repository with code/configs/IDs/environment/results/README and attribution; no raw datasets or unnecessary large weights. One eight-page NeurIPS main report for all3 tasks, references/optional appendix outside limit; repo link at end of abstract. Report prose/publication deferred in current scope.
